purpose: Bounded holdout diagnostic against independent model readings, not human gold or population accuracy
education_detected: Any education evidence flagged is_applicant_requirement or is_applicant_qualification_candidate, excluding negated_or_optional and ambiguous_abbreviation. Covers qualified degree signals, including accepted alternatives; does not claim mandatory degree.
experience_detected: Same qualification flags in experience module; exclude negated_or_optional and explicit_no_experience.
explicit_no_experience_detected: Any explicit_no_experience flag in experience evidence outside company/benefits/duties/equal_opportunity/application_policy contexts; conditional role applicability remains unresolved.
unsupported_strength: unknown or context_conflict not silently set mandatory; unresolved qualification paths not collapsed
reference: Primary counts only where two reviewers agree yes/no; unclear/disagreement reported separately; root adjudication documented explicitly. Full-text exact quotes checked.
scoring: TP/FP/FN/TN at ad level vs agreed labels; precision/recall and Wilson95 intervals only for this finite selected pack; not weighted population inference. Numeric duration/path errors separately reviewed.
release_gate: Zero parsing errors is insufficient. Any systematic context/path failure blocks using that broad module as a validated outcome. Performance-only batch may proceed with candidate-only=true even when semantics fails. No full-corpus semantic release on24 ads regardless of observed accuracy.
